name: AURORA
description: Elevate your lifestyle with the Aurora model, where luxury meets practical living in perfect harmony. This sophisticated 2,227 square foot home features 4 bedrooms and 3 full bathrooms, designed for families who appreciate both elegance and functionality. The open concept layout with vaulted ceilings creates an impressive sense of space, while the gourmet kitchen with custom cabinets and granite countertops becomes the heart of your home. Every selection—from energy-efficient appliances to thoughtful lighting—has been made with your family's comfort in mind. The Aurora doesn't just meet expectations; it creates a living experience that truly feels like home.
